program_model.instance_model: primary monument shown single-sided (Type 1) and double-sided (Type 3)

knowledge.plain_language_summary: A multi-element cabinet monument: a primary fabricated aluminum cabinet plus a logo cabinet with face-and-halo illuminated acrylic letters, a painted reveal, and modular tenant panels, carried on an internal steel-pipe structure in an engineered rebar footing.
knowledge.rationale: The engineered steel-pipe-in-concrete substructure (not the aluminum skin) carries the load, so the archetype is a composite structure; the logo cabinet and reveal/tenant-panel system are modular and serviceable.

structure.construction: fabricated aluminum 2in-13in+ deep with 0.090in skin and 1.5in angle frames, on 4in/6in dia Sch40 steel pipe set 36in in 3500psi poured footing with #5 rebar cage 12in OC
fabricated aluminum 3in deep with 3/4in illuminated acrylic logo letters, face- and halo-illuminated
fabricated aluminum reveal 1-2in deep painted medium/dark gray; extruded aluminum tenant panels 1.5-3in deep; 3mm/6mm Dibond faces with opaque/translucent 3M vinyl

craft_observations: Engineered steel-pipe substructure + rebar footing = composite structure, not a simple cabinet.
Face-and-halo acrylic logo adds dimensional depth; modular reveal/tenant panels are serviceable.

open_items: Structural footing/rebar engineered; HDU element noted on one logo cabinet
